scale_neutral_numeric_erratum.issue: After within-race z-scoring, score_mean and score_std are mathematically fixed at approximately 0 and 1. Tiny floating-point residual patterns can be exploited by tree models and therefore are not meaningful scale-neutral realism information.
scale_neutral_numeric_erratum.correction_semantics: Post-result diagnostic only. Remove score_mean and score_std from SCALE_NEUTRAL_VIEW because they are deterministic normalization identities; retain score_range and all non-score features.
scale_neutral_numeric_erratum.conclusion_change: NONE_MATERIAL. The exact numeric HGB separability is lower than the original scale-neutral locked output, but the new Twin remains materially distinguishable nonlinearly while being dramatically improved versus the current Twin.

fixed_hgb_group_diagnostic_on_empirical_.single_feature_observation: No single tactical feature alone produced high separability; the strongest single diagnostic was zero_nige at AUC about 0.565. The large multifeature AUC is therefore primarily a joint/dependence signature rather than one bad marginal center.
